title: DECASTE: Unveiling Caste Stereotypes in Large Language Models through Multi-Dimensional Bias Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Implicit bias probing using caste-associated surnames to measure assignments of stereotypical words (Stereotypical Word Association Task), and explicit bias probing using a persona-based scenario answering task that evaluates how models assign roles and tasks to personas explicitly labeled with different castes (Persona-based Scenario Answering Task).
